text.hi: पाँचों दोस्त धौलपुर के मेले में पहुँच गए हैं! अब वे झूले झूलेंगे, खाना खाएँगे, और फिर एक मुश्किल आएगी। पहले किताब के सवाल।
text.hinglish: Paanchon dost Dholpur ke mele mein pahunch gaye hain! Ab woh jhoole jhoolenge, khaana khaayenge, aur phir ek mushkil aayegi. Pehle kitaab ke sawaal.
text.en: The five friends have reached the Dholpur fair! They will enjoy the rides and food, and then face a problem. First, the book's questions.

replies.say: Yes, I like swings very much.

meaning.hi: हाँ, मुझे झूले बहुत पसंद हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Haan, mujhe jhoole bahut pasand hain.

meaning.hi: नहीं, झूलों से मुझे चक्कर आते हैं।
meaning.hinglish: Nahi, jhoolon se mujhe chakkar aate hain.

turns.tinku: Which ride have you enjoyed the most?

meaning.hi: तुम्हें कौन सा झूला सबसे ज़्यादा अच्छा लगा?
meaning.hinglish: Tumhe kaun sa jhoola sabse zyaada achha laga?

replies.say: I enjoyed the giant wheel the most.

meaning.hi: मुझे बड़ा झूला सबसे ज़्यादा अच्छा लगा।
meaning.hinglish: Mujhe bada jhoola sabse zyaada achha laga.

steps.meaning: food that makes your stomach full
steps.example: Dal and rice is a filling meal.

exampleMeaning.hi: दाल-चावल पेट भरने वाला खाना है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Daal-chaawal pet bharne waala khaana hai.

steps.meaning: feeling that things are spinning round you
steps.example: The fast swing made me dizzy.

exampleMeaning.hi: तेज़ झूले से मुझे चक्कर आ गए।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Tez jhoole se mujhe chakkar aa gaye.

exampleMeaning.hi: हमारे पास लकड़ी की मेज़ है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Hamare paas lakdi ki mez hai.

steps.meaning: to put money together with others
steps.example: We pooled our money to buy a cake.

exampleMeaning.hi: हमने केक ख़रीदने के लिए पैसे मिलाए।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Humne cake khareedne ke liye paise milaaye.

steps.meaning: that you can get or use
steps.example: Tickets are available at the counter.

steps.meaning: travelling from one place to another
steps.example: The journey to Delhi takes ten hours.

exampleMeaning.hi: दिल्ली का सफ़र दस घंटे का है।
exampleMeaning.hinglish: Delhi ka safar das ghante ka hai.
